run_main_generate_fake_data: run the cats_vs_dogs module to generate fake dataset zip with sample cat and dog images
run_main_with_tfds_dir: run the cats_vs_dogs script with a custom tfds_dir flag to specify output directory
use_fake_data_utils_get_random_jpeg: use fake_data_utils.get_random_jpeg to generate a random JPEG image for testing
use_zipfile_create_archive: use zipfile to create a zip archive with nested PetImages/Cat and PetImages/Dog directories
use_output_dir_path: use _output_dir to compute the fake examples output path under tfds_dir/testing/test_data/fake_examples/cats_vs_dogs
